description: Windturbines - vermogen is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Op deze kaart ziet u de locatie en het vermogen van alle windturbines in Nederland. De positie van de turbines op zee is minder nauwkeurig in beeld gebracht dan op land. Gebruik voor de exacte locatie van de turbines op zee de gegevens van Rijkswaterstaat. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are ashoogte, rotordiameter, vermogen, windenergie. It offers 10 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-02-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
